sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一座葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，体内血被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.en: At PwC, we optimize the systems that put your data to work, so you can scale your AI from proof of concept to competitive edge,
sentences.zh: 在普华永道，我们优化让数据发挥作用的系统，助力您的 AI 从概念验证迈向竞争优势，

sentences.en: and accelerate your tech evolution so you can redefine what's possible.
sentences.zh: 并加速您的技术演进，让您重新定义无限可能。

sentences.en: From blueprint to breakthrough, we take you further with tech.
sentences.zh: 从蓝图到突破，我们以科技助您行稳致远。

sentences.en: So you can outthink, outpace, and outperform.
sentences.zh: 助您思虑更深、步伐更快、表现更卓越。

sentences.en: PwC, so you can.
sentences.zh: 普华永道，成就可能。

sentences.en: PwC refers to the PwC network and or one or more of its member firms, each of which is a separate legal entity.
sentences.zh: 普华永道是指普华永道网络及/或其一家或多家成员机构，每家机构均为独立的法律实体。

sentences.en: Hello, it's Casey here.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是凯西。

sentences.en: I just wanted to take a moment to explain why you're hearing something a little different on the Casefile feed.
sentences.zh: 我只想花点时间解释一下，为什么大家会在 Casefile 的节目源里听到一些不太一样的声音。

sentences.en: Over the past year, I've had the chance to meet Casefile listeners at our live shows, and something kept coming up in conversations that surprised me.
sentences.zh: 过去这一年里，我有机会在线下见面会上见到 Casefile 的听众，而谈话中有一点让我感到很意外。

sentences.en: A lot of people don't know what Casefile Presents is, or that we produce other shows.
sentences.zh: 很多人并不知道什么是 Casefile Presents，也不知道我们还制作其他节目。

sentences.en: If someone is a big enough supporter of Casefile to come to a live event, but hasn't heard of Casefile Presents, it occurred to me that we need to work on our messaging.
sentences.zh: 如果有人足够支持 Casefile，甚至专程来参加线下活动，却没听说过 Casefile Presents，我意识到我们需要改进宣传方式。

sentences.en: For those who don't know, Casefile Presents is our production platform.
sentences.zh: 对于不太了解的人，Casefile Presents 是我们的制作平台。

sentences.en: The main show we produce is, of course, Casefile.
sentences.zh: 我们制作的主打节目当然是 Casefile。

sentences.en: But we've also produced a number of other podcasts.
sentences.zh: 但我们也制作了许多其他播客。

sentences.en: Our level of involvement varies from show to show, but we've had a direct hand in all of them, whether it be in financing, research, production, editing, or music.
sentences.zh: 我们对每档节目的参与程度各不相同，但无论是资金、调研、制作、剪辑还是音乐，我们都直接参与其中。

sentences.en: I even narrate a few of them myself.
sentences.zh: 甚至有几档节目是我亲自担任旁白的。

sentences.en: With Casefile and a short break, we thought this would be a great time to shine a light on some of the shows that may have flown under the radar for many of you.
sentences.zh: 借着 Casefile 短暂休息的契机，我们觉得这是个绝佳的时机，来向大家介绍一些可能被许多人忽视的精彩节目。

sentences.en: These are shows we've put our hearts into, and are really proud of.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我们倾注了心血、引以为傲的节目。

sentences.en: First up is Missing Niamh, a story that's very close to me personally.
sentences.zh: 首先是《寻找尼娅姆》（Missing Niamh），这是一个对我个人而言非常亲近的故事。

sentences.en: I spent years researching the case, and working directly with members of Niamh's family to shape the series, which I also narrated.
sentences.zh: 我花了几年时间研究这起案件，并与尼娅姆家属直接合作来构建这个系列，这也是我担任旁白的节目。

sentences.en: And yes, I know the traditional pronunciation of Niamh is Niamh.
sentences.zh: 是的，我知道 Niamh 的传统发音是尼娅姆。

sentences.en: The reason why her loved ones called her Niamh is explained early in episode 1.
sentences.zh: 她在第一集开头就解释了为什么她所爱的人叫她尼娅姆。

sentences.en: The series went to number 1 in Australia and remained there for quite a while.
sentences.zh: 这个系列在澳大利亚登顶榜首并保持了相当长一段时间。

sentences.en: It also charted highly around the world, racking up millions of downloads.
sentences.zh: 它在世界各地也名列前茅，斩获了数百万次下载量。

sentences.en: Regardless of its success, it's an important story, and I think it deserves more ears.
sentences.zh: 抛开成功与否不谈，这是一个重要的故事，我认为它值得被更多人听到。

sentences.en: Because of that, we are releasing the first episode here on the Casefile feed.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我们正在 Casefile 节目源里发布第一集。

sentences.en: If you like it, you can find the rest of the series by searching Missing Niamh wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢，可以在各大播客平台搜索《寻找尼娅姆》来收听节目的其余部分。

sentences.en: Now, here is episode 1.
sentences.zh: 现在，请听第一集。

sentences.en: When 18-year-old Niamh May went missing back in 2002, her family did everything they could to help police try and find her.
sentences.zh: 2002 年，18 岁的尼娅姆·梅失踪时，她的家人竭尽全力协助警方寻找她。

sentences.en: But, like so many missing persons cases, there comes a time when the leads dry up and there's nowhere left to look.
sentences.zh: 但是，就像许多失踪人口案件一样，总会遇到线索中断、无处可寻的时候。

sentences.en: Back then, there were no podcasts, and social media was still a couple of years away.
sentences.zh: 在那个年代，还没有播客，社交媒体也还要几年时间才会出现。

sentences.en: But, times change, and in recent years,
sentences.zh: 不过，时代在变，近年来，

sentences.en: Niamh's sister Fanula began listening to true crime podcasts and realised their potential to make a huge difference, especially in unsolved cases like theirs.
sentences.zh: 尼娅姆的姐姐法努拉开始收听真实罪案播客，并意识到它们发挥巨大作用的潜力，特别是在像他们这样未破的案件中。

sentences.en: She realised that a podcast about Niamh might bring about the answers the family were looking for.
sentences.zh: 她意识到，一档关于尼娅姆的播客可能会带来家属一直在寻找的答案。

sentences.en: When Fanula contacted us, we agreed to help her reinvigorate the investigation into what happened to Niamh.
sentences.zh: 当法努拉联系我们时，我们同意协助她重启对尼娅姆遭遇的调查。

sentences.en: So, for the last few years,
sentences.zh: 因此，在过去的几年里，

sentences.en: I've been working with Fanula to take a much closer look at Niamh's case.
sentences.zh: 我一直与法努拉合作，对尼娅姆的案件进行更深入的调查。

sentences.en: Even as I worked on other Casefile projects, I carried Niamh's story with me at all times.
sentences.zh: 即使在处理其他 Casefile 项目时，我也时刻把尼娅姆的故事放在心上。

sentences.en: Maybe it was because we were the same age, or we finished high school the same year.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为我们同岁，或者我们在同一年高中毕业。

sentences.en: Maybe it was the fact that we both wanted a gap year after leaving school, or that we liked similar music.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为我们俩都想在毕业后有一年的间隔年，或者我们喜欢相似的音乐。

sentences.en: Or maybe it was the fact that Niamh was a young 18-year-old testing the waters of life, and something pulled her under.
sentences.zh: 又或者是因为尼娅姆是一个刚刚试水人生的年轻 18 岁女孩，却被某种力量无情吞没。

sentences.en: And that could have happened to any of us.
sentences.zh: 而这本来可能发生在任何人身上。

sentences.en: Maybe we just got lucky and survived our teenage years.
sentences.zh: 也许我们只是比较幸运，度过了青少年时期。

sentences.en: But Niamh didn't.
sentences.zh: 但尼娅姆没有。

sentences.en: She didn't get to realise her potential.
sentences.zh: 她没能实现自己的潜力。

sentences.en: When I first started looking into this case in 2020, it was originally intended to be a Casefile episode.
sentences.zh: 当我 2020 年最初开始调查这起案件时，它原本只打算做成一期 Casefile 节目。

sentences.en: But the more I looked, a series of revelations unfolded that literally and figuratively took me to places that I could never have anticipated.
sentences.zh: 但随着我深入调查，一系列真相浮出水面，无论是字面还是实际意义上，都把我带到了我从未预料到的地方。

sentences.en: Niamh grew up in a large Catholic family in Armadale in northern New South Wales.
sentences.zh: 尼娅姆在新南威尔士州北部的阿马代尔的一个大家庭长大，这是一个天主教家庭。

sentences.en: After finishing her final year at school, she took a working holiday and went fruit-picking down south in Batlow.
sentences.zh: 完成高中的最后一年后，她进行了一次工作度假，前往南部巴特洛摘水果。

sentences.en: Niamh phoned home regularly, and as Easter 2002 approached, she made plans to travel back home to Armadale to spend Easter with her family.
sentences.zh: 尼娅姆定期给家里打电话，随着 2002 年复活节的临近，她计划回阿马代尔与家人共度复活节。

sentences.en: It wasn't until I started sort of talking to Mum and Dad more about it and looking into it more that I realised how much they took on.
sentences.zh: 直到我开始和爸妈更多地谈论这件事并深入了解后，我才意识到他们承受了多少。

sentences.en: So, Dad retired the year that Niamh finished school.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在尼娅姆毕业那年退休了。

sentences.en: Mum had retired a few years earlier.
sentences.zh: 妈妈几年前就退休了。

sentences.en: They had seven kids.
sentences.zh: 他们有七个孩子。

sentences.en: They'd just got them all off their hands and less than three months later, their youngest daughter goes missing, presumably murdered.
sentences.zh: 他们刚把所有孩子抚养长大，不到三个月后，他们的小女儿就失踪了，据推测已经遇害。

sentences.en: And they've spent the next 18 years searching for her.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的 18 年里，他们一直在寻找她。

sentences.en: They light a candle for her every morning.
sentences.zh: 他们每天早上都为她点燃蜡烛。

sentences.en: And in the early years, I think Dad said they went down there 30 times.
sentences.zh: 在头几年里，我想爸爸说过他们去过那里 30 次。

sentences.en: And it's a 10-hour, yeah, about 10 to 12-hour drive from Armadale down there and back again.
sentences.zh: 从阿马代尔到那里单程大约需要 10 到 12 个小时的车程。

sentences.en: And they were so methodical about it and they had a huge map on the study wall at home and they'd marked off all the areas that they'd searched and they, you know,
sentences.zh: 他们做事极其有条理，家里书房的墙上挂着一张巨大的地图，上面标出了他们搜寻过的所有区域，而且，你知道的，

sentences.en: they've got crazy people contacting them with potential sightings, some of whom, you know, claim to be psychic.
sentences.zh: 有形形色色的人联系他们提供可能的目击线索，其中有些人自称是通灵者。

sentences.en: But they also have just spent time in the local towns talking to the local volunteers and obviously working with the police tirelessly.
sentences.zh: 但他们也花时间在当地城镇与当地志愿者交谈，并显然与警方进行了不懈的合作。

sentences.en: I knew that it was consuming for them, but I don't think I realised how much they really took on
sentences.zh: 我知道这对他们是一种煎熬，但我觉得我并没有意识到他们真正承受了多少，

sentences.en: because they shielded it from us.
sentences.zh: 因为他们把这些都瞒着我们。

sentences.en: At no point have we just got on with our lives, if you know what I mean.
sentences.zh: 我们从没有真正继续过自己的生活，如果你明白我的意思的话。

sentences.en: Like, I heard something recently that really resonated.
sentences.zh: 就像我最近听到的一句话，真的很有共鸣。

sentences.en: It was a woman from America who said that you never get over grief, you learn to move forward with it.
sentences.zh: 有个美国女人说，你永远无法摆脱悲伤，你只是学会带着悲伤继续前行。

sentences.en: And I was like, that's, yeah, that's the best anyone's ever described it.
sentences.zh: 当时我就觉得，对，这就是对它最好的描述。

sentences.en: Niamh May was born on the 21st of June, 1983.
sentences.zh: 尼娅姆·梅出生于 1983 年 6 月 21 日。

sentences.en: She grew up on a small hobby farm in Armadale, New South Wales, which is almost 500 kilometres north of Sydney, the state capital.
sentences.zh: 她在新南威尔士州阿马代尔的一个小型爱好农场长大，这里距离首府悉尼以北近 500 公里。

sentences.en: The May family, mum and dad, Anne and Brian, and children, Catherine, Susan, Kieran, Justine,
sentences.zh: 梅一家，爸爸妈妈安和布莱恩，以及孩子们凯瑟琳、苏珊、基兰、朱斯廷、

sentences.en: Tamsin, Fanula and Niamh were raised Catholic.
sentences.zh: 塔姆辛、法努拉和尼娅姆，都是天主教徒。

sentences.en: Niamh was the youngest of the bunch, with her sister Fanula only two years older.
sentences.zh: 尼娅姆是家里最小的孩子，她的姐姐法努拉只比她大两岁。

sentences.en: All the children were close-knit.
sentences.zh: 所有孩子关系都非常紧密。

sentences.en: Growing up out of town,
sentences.zh: 在镇外长大的日子里，

sentences.en: Niamh and her brother and sisters had the kind of childhood you might daydream about.
sentences.zh: 尼娅姆和她的兄弟姐妹们度过了那种你会无限向往的童年。

sentences.en: Imagine the Australian countryside, blue skies with cotton ball clouds, kids making their own fun, running wild in open fields as free as the wind.
sentences.zh: 想象一下澳大利亚的乡村，棉花糖般的云朵映衬着蓝天，孩子们自己寻找乐趣，在广阔的田野里像风一样自由奔跑。

sentences.en: They were safe, as long as they avoided the snakes in the grass and the redback spiders in the retaining wall.
sentences.zh: 只要避开草丛里的蛇和挡土墙里的红背蜘蛛，他们就是安全的。

sentences.en: Before we get too far into Niamh's story, we should clarify her name.
sentences.zh: 在我们深入讲述尼娅姆的故事之前，我们先澄清一下她的名字。

sentences.en: Niamh is an Irish name, spelt N-I-A-M-H, and traditionally pronounced Niamh.
sentences.zh: Niamh 是一个爱尔兰名字，拼写为 N-I-A-M-H，传统发音是尼娅姆。

sentences.en: Her sister Fanula explains how her parents adjusted their daughter's name for the Australian palate.
sentences.zh: 她的姐姐法努拉解释了他们的父母是如何为了适应澳大利亚人的发音习惯而调整女儿的名字的。

sentences.en: She was named Niamh, the Irish name Niamh, but Mum and Dad decided that was going to be too hard for people in the 80s in Australia, in country New South Wales,
sentences.zh: 她被取名为 Niamh，爱尔兰名字 Niamh，但爸爸妈妈觉得在 80 年代的澳大利亚乡村，新南威尔士州，人们很难弄明白

sentences.en: to work out that M-H was a V sound.
sentences.zh: M-H 发的是 V 的音。

sentences.en: So they said, oh, we'll just drop the H and everyone can call her Niamh like Liam.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说，好吧，我们干脆去掉 H，所有人都可以像念 Liam 那样叫她尼娅姆。

sentences.en: So we all grew up calling her Niamh.
sentences.zh: 于是我们从小到大都叫她尼娅姆。

sentences.en: So while we will call her Niamh, you might hear others call her Niamh.
sentences.zh: 所以虽然我们会叫她尼娅姆，但你可能会听到其他人叫她 Niamh。

sentences.en: When Niamh's Mum and Dad,
sentences.zh: 当尼娅姆的爸爸妈妈

sentences.en: Anne and Brian, first met, they were both primary school teachers.
sentences.zh: 安和布莱恩初次相遇时，他们都是小学老师。

sentences.en: Before Fanula and Niamh were born,
sentences.zh: 在法努拉和尼娅姆出生之前，

sentences.en: Brian did his PhD and became a lecturer at the University of New England in Armidale, where he worked for many years.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩攻读了博士学位，并成为阿马代尔新英格兰大学的讲师，在那里工作多年。

sentences.en: Anne continued to teach primary school while having her children and also studied her master's in education.
sentences.zh: 安在抚养孩子的同时继续教小学，还攻读了教育学硕士学位。

sentences.en: While pregnant with Niamh,
sentences.zh: 怀着尼娅姆期间，

sentences.en: Anne sat her final exam and won the University Medal.
sentences.zh: 安参加了期末考试并获得了大学奖章。

sentences.en: Anne describes what life was like when Niamh was born.
sentences.zh: 安描述了尼娅姆出生时的生活是什么样的。

sentences.en: Well, she was born very easily.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她出生得很顺利。

sentences.en: Number seven fitted in very easily
sentences.zh: 老七很轻松地融入了家庭，

sentences.en: and had six bigger siblings who, if she stepped out of line, could bring her back into line.
sentences.zh: 她有六个较大的哥哥姐姐，如果她有越轨行为，他们会把她拉回正轨。

sentences.en: It didn't fall on me, which was very handy.
sentences.zh: 这不用我操心，非常省事。

sentences.en: But on the whole, she just fitted in.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，她很自然地融入了进来。

sentences.en: She used to love using her little hand puppets and playing games with them and making up stories.
sentences.zh: 她以前非常喜欢用她的小手偶玩游戏并编造故事。

sentences.en: Even though Fanula was only a small child herself, she still remembers Niamh as a baby.
sentences.zh: 尽管法努拉自己当时还是个小孩子，但她依然记得尼娅姆还是个婴儿时的样子。

sentences.en: We grew up together.
sentences.zh: 我们是一起长大的。

sentences.en: She was my little pal.
sentences.zh: 她是我的小伙伴。

sentences.en: So her and the sister above me, Tamsin, we were known as the three little kids, the little kids.
sentences.zh: 所以她和比我大一点的姐姐塔姆辛，我们被称为三个小不点，小孩子们。

sentences.en: So we all shared a bedroom.
sentences.zh: 我们共用一个卧室。

sentences.en: It was the little kids' room.
sentences.zh: 那就是小孩子们的房间。

sentences.en: And even, I think, as adults, I remember one Christmas not even that long ago, someone said, like,
sentences.zh: 甚至我觉得，作为成年人，我记得不久前的一个圣诞节，有人说，比如，

sentences.en: I'll get one of the little kids to do it.
sentences.zh: “让其中一个小不点去做吧。”

sentences.en: I'm like, I'm like 30-something.
sentences.zh: 我说，我都三十多岁了。

sentences.en: So we've kept our family positions regardless of our age.
sentences.zh: 所以无论年龄多大，我们在家里的小地位一直没变。

sentences.en: Yeah, so Niamh's chubby cheeks.
sentences.zh: 对，还有尼娅姆肉嘟嘟的脸颊。

sentences.en: Little cutie with absolutely adorable little chubby cheeks.
sentences.zh: 绝对是个可爱的小不点，有着惹人怜爱的小胖脸。

sentences.en: And she was, you know, spoiled being the youngeSt.
sentences.zh: 而且作为老小，你知道的，她被宠坏了。

sentences.en: Everyone called her Chuppa Bubba.
sentences.zh: 大家都叫她 Chuppa Bubba。

sentences.en: And she could chuck a tantrum.
sentences.zh: 她也挺会发脾气的。

sentences.en: From blueprint to breakthrough, we take you further with tech so you can outthink, outpace and outperform.
sentences.zh: 从蓝图到突破，我们以科技助您走得更远，让您思虑更深、步伐更快、表现更卓越。

sentences.zh: 普华永道，成就可能。

sentences.zh: 普华永道是指普华永道网络及/或其一家或多家成员机构，每家成员机构均为独立的法律实体。

sentences.en: So, to her family, Niamh was fearless, outspoken and very clever.
sentences.zh: 因此，在家人眼中，妮娅姆无所畏惧、直言不讳而且非常聪明。

sentences.en: What was she like to her peers?
sentences.zh: 她在同龄人眼中是什么样的呢？

sentences.en: Niamh's childhood friend, Jess, describes her as a humanitarian and a leader.
sentences.zh: 妮娅姆的童年好友杰丝形容她是一个人道主义者和领袖。

sentences.en: Niamh and I went to, we met in kindergarten and we went from kindergarten all the way up to year 12 together.
sentences.zh: 我和妮娅姆相识于幼儿园，我们从幼儿园一直到十二年级都在一起。

sentences.en: And we were in the same friendship group, just like a little close bunch of friends.
sentences.zh: 我们属于同一个朋友圈，就像一小群关系紧密的朋友。

sentences.en: There was like seven of us that were very close and we're all still close.
sentences.zh: 我们大约有七个人关系非常好，而且我们至今仍然很亲密。

sentences.en: And Niamh was very academic and she was a leader.
sentences.zh: 妮娅姆学术成绩很好，她是一个领袖。

sentences.en: She was very influential, had a lot of humanitarian traits from a young age, always stick up for the underdog and or, you know, what she believed in.
sentences.zh: 她很有影响力，从小就具有很多人道主义特质，总是为弱势群体挺身而出，或者说，为她所信仰的事业发声。

sentences.en: As a student on a school outing, Niamh spoke her mind to Midnight Oil frontman turned politician, Peter Garrett.
sentences.zh: 作为一名参加学校远足的学生，妮娅姆向由摇滚乐队“午夜油”（Midnight Oil）主唱转行为政客的彼得·加勒特（Peter Garrett）直抒胸臆。

sentences.en: We once went to the university to see Peter Garrett speak when he was the environmental minister and we were, I think we were in year 11 or year 12.
sentences.zh: 我们曾去大学听彼得·加勒特演讲，当时他是环境部长，我想我们当时在上十一年级或十二年级。

sentences.en: And, you know, we all sunk back in our seats when she stood up and Mike gave him a big serving about her thoughts on his position and what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，当她站起来用麦克风狠狠地就他的立场和他的所作所为发表了自己的看法时，我们所有人都吓得缩回了座位里。

sentences.en: Niamh completed her high school certificate in 2001 and scored in the top 5% of the state.
sentences.zh: 妮娅姆于2001年完成了高中学业，成绩名列全州前5%。

sentences.en: She applied to study at the University of Technology in Sydney and was accepted to study film.
sentences.zh: 她申请就读悉尼科技大学，并被录取学习电影专业。

sentences.en: Niamh decided to take a gap year in 2002, save up a bit of money and go to university the year after.
sentences.zh: 妮娅姆决定在2002年gap year（间隔年），攒点钱，第二年再去上大学。

sentences.en: It was a decision that changed the lives of the May family forever.
sentences.zh: 这个决定永远改变了梅一家的生活。

sentences.en: Niamh heard through friends about fruit picking.
sentences.zh: 妮娅姆从朋友那里听说了摘水果这回事。

sentences.en: It sounded like a perfect opportunity to save a bit of cash, see Australia and spend some time outdoors.
sentences.zh: 这听起来是个攒点钱、看看澳大利亚并花点时间亲近大自然的绝佳机会。

sentences.en: For Niamh, it also meant she could set off on adventures and test her independence.
sentences.zh: 对妮娅姆来说，这也意味着她可以踏上冒险之旅并检验自己的独立能力。

sentences.en: Her friend Jess had a similar idea.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友杰丝也有类似的想法。

sentences.en: And she planned to go to UTS in Sydney to study film and I was going to do music in Brisbane.
sentences.zh: 她计划去悉尼的悉尼科技大学学电影，而我打算去布里斯班学音乐。

sentences.en: We decided to go on some kind of road trip around Australia.
sentences.zh: 我们决定进行某种环澳大利亚的公路旅行。

sentences.en: So, you know, like take a year off and just leave home and go on an adventure.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，就像是请假一年，离开家去进行一次冒险。

sentences.en: It wasn't well planned out at all, but I think it was just exciting, you know, the prospect of finishing school and having a year off before going into any kind of other studies.
sentences.zh: 这根本没有经过周密的计划，但我觉得这很令人兴奋，你知道的，那种刚毕业并拥有一年假期、不用急着投入任何其他学习的前景。

sentences.en: And three of our other friends had been fruit picking and they had taken a trip previously to this particular area that we went.
sentences.zh: 我们的另外三个朋友曾经去摘过水果，他们之前去过我们去的这个特定地区。

sentences.en: It's easy to see why this idea would have appealed to Niamh.
sentences.zh: 不难看出为什么这个想法会吸引妮娅姆。

sentences.en: Taking a gap year between school and university gives teenagers a sense of freedom that's unlikely ever to be duplicated.
sentences.zh: 在学校和大学之间留出间隔年，会给年轻人一种几乎不可能再复制的自由感。

sentences.en: A whole year stretching ahead with no timetables, no particular places to be, not a care in the world.
sentences.zh: 整整一年在前方展开，没有时间表，没有特定的去处，无忧无虑。

sentences.en: It feels like forever is lying just in front of you.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得永远就像在眼前一样。

sentences.en: And for the young and idealistic, it's a time to test yourself and find out who you really are.
sentences.zh: 对于年轻且充满理想主义的人来说，这是一个考验自己并发现真正的自己的时期。

sentences.en: Perhaps it is natural that prospective fruit pickers head to Batlow, famed for its apples.
sentences.zh: 潜在的果园采摘工们前往以苹果闻名的巴特洛（Batlow），也许是很自然的事。

sentences.en: It's a small character-filled town dotted with apple orchards that produce enough to supply 10% of Australia's apples.
sentences.zh: 那是一个充满特色的小镇，点缀着大片的苹果园，其产量足以供应澳大利亚10%的苹果。

sentences.en: Niamh arrived in Batlow at the end of January 2002, fully intent on fruit picking and living the fruit picker's lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 妮娅姆于2002年1月底抵达巴特洛，满心打算摘水果并体验采摘工的生活方式。

sentences.en: But it would prove a false start.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明这是一次出师不利的开始。

sentences.en: She only got a couple of days of work before unseasonal summer rains cancelled most of the picking.
sentences.zh: 她只工作了几天，不合时节的夏雨就取消了大部分的采摘工作。

sentences.en: In a few weeks, Niamh was back home with not much more to show for her travels than photos of her on-the-job war wounds, mainly bruises from fruit totes and ladders.
sentences.zh: 几个星期后，妮娅姆回到了家，这次旅行留给她的除了记录工作“战伤”的照片外别无他物，主要是水果箱和梯子造成的瘀伤。

sentences.en: Undaunted by the first trip, Niamh couldn't wait to return to Batlow when the weather settled.
sentences.zh: 第一次的旅行并未让她气馁，天气稳定后，妮娅姆迫不及待地想要重返巴特洛。

sentences.en: She had only been home for four days when she and her dad went shopping to buy some camping gear for her next trip.
sentences.zh: 她回家才四天，就和爸爸一起去买露营装备，为下一次旅行做准备。

sentences.en: She talked over her plans with Brian.
sentences.zh: 她和布莱恩商量了她的计划。

sentences.en: I can recall when she came home the first time, when she said she wanted to go apple picking in Batlow.
sentences.zh: 我能想起她第一次回家的时候，当时她说她想去巴特洛摘苹果。

sentences.en: I asked her why she would want to do that sort of work.
sentences.zh: 我问她为什么想去做那种工作。

sentences.en: I grew up myself on a banana and tomato farm, pineapples and other tropical fruits, so I knew what was involved in labouring in the fields.
sentences.zh: 我自己是在一个香蕉和西红柿农场长大的，还种过菠萝和其他热带水果，所以我很清楚田间劳作是怎么回事。

sentences.en: And I said, you know, it's a hard job.
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道的，那是一份辛苦的工作。

sentences.en: And she said, well, I'd just like to try and see how I go.
sentences.zh: 她说，嗯，我只是想尝试一下，看看自己行不行。

sentences.en: I was, well, I was hoping you might help me out.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，我希望你能帮我一把。

sentences.en: Whereupon I agreed and we went and had checked out the tent.
sentences.zh: 于是我同意了，我们去查看了那个帐篷。

sentences.en: Of course, we used to take the family camping quite a bit when they were all young.
sentences.zh: 当然，在孩子们小的时候，我们经常带家人去露营。

sentences.en: So she was familiar with camping.
sentences.zh: 所以她对露营并不陌生。

sentences.en: She was familiar with travelling.
sentences.zh: 她对旅行并不陌生。

sentences.en: Niamh's mum, Anne, tried to make her daughter aware of the difficulties she might face on her fruit picking year.
sentences.zh: 妮娅姆的妈妈安试图让女儿意识到她去摘水果这一年可能会面临的困难。

sentences.en: It might not be as rosy as she thought.
sentences.zh: 情况可能不像她想的那么美好。

sentences.en: But Niamh was not to be discouraged.
sentences.zh: 但妮娅姆并没有气馁。

sentences.en: Her friend Jess remembers how excited Niamh was to go back to fruit picking after her brief stint.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友杰丝回忆起妮娅姆在短暂的尝试后，再次打算去摘水果时是多么兴奋。

sentences.en: And then she came back and she was really excited and she said, let's go fruit picking.
sentences.zh: 然后她回来了，非常兴奋，说我们去摘水果吧。

sentences.en: You know, it was summertime.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那是夏天。

sentences.en: I'd just turned 18.
sentences.zh: 我刚满18岁。

sentences.en: And she said, you know, stuff this.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道的，别管这些了。

sentences.en: Like, you know, I think we both had like cafe jobs or something.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道的，我觉得我们俩当时都有咖啡馆的工作什么的。

sentences.en: And, you know, she was like, let's, you know, let's go out into the bush.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，她就像是在说，我们去，你知道的，我们去丛林里吧。

sentences.en: Let's go and pick fruit.
sentences.zh: 我们去摘水果吧。

sentences.en: We can get fit.
sentences.zh: 我们可以锻炼身体。

sentences.en: We can be healthy.
sentences.zh: 我们可以变得健康。

sentences.en: You know, we can go on an adventure and we can make some money.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们可以去冒险，还能挣点钱。

sentences.en: We can buy a car and we can drive to Brisbane and we'll go on, you know, we'll visit some friends.
sentences.zh: 我们可以买辆车，开车去布里斯班，然后去，你知道的，去拜访一些朋友。

sentences.en: Who had already started uni and that's how the idea came.
sentences.zh: 他们已经开始上大学了，这个想法就是这样来的。

sentences.en: So her and I decided to go.
sentences.zh: 所以她和我决定去。

sentences.en: We booked a train ticket from Armadale to Sydney and we were going to stay with her sister Fanula for one night.
sentences.zh: 我们预订了从阿马代尔到悉尼的火车票，打算在她姐姐范妮拉家住一晚。

sentences.en: And then we would carry on to this place called Batlow.
sentences.zh: 然后我们要继续前往一个叫巴特洛的地方。

sentences.en: Jess put her trust in Niamh's planning skills.
sentences.zh: 杰丝对妮娅姆的规划能力深信不疑。

sentences.en: Niamh had always been quite fastidious with details and organisational skills.
sentences.zh: 妮娅姆一直对细节和组织能力非常严谨挑剔。

sentences.en: Like for my whole life, she was the person that would, you know, she was known as a good organiser.
sentences.zh: 就像在我整个人生中，她就是那种，你知道的，被称为擅长组织的人。

sentences.en: So I kind of just booked this train ticket and thought that she knew what we were doing and where we were going and how it was working, how it was going to work.
sentences.zh: 所以我基本上只是订了这张火车票，心想她知道我们在做什么、要去哪里、这是怎么运作的、接下来会怎么进行。

sentences.en: And there was, yeah, you know, there was a lot of trust that we would just be taken care of.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，你知道的，我们非常信任一切都会被安排妥当。

sentences.en: You know, we were going to somehow we would get to Batlow train and bus and then we would go to this camping ground.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们打算无论如何都要坐火车和巴士去巴特洛，然后去这个露营地。

sentences.en: And, you know, we just supposedly, if we just went to the caravan park and pitched a tent, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们本以为只要去房车公园搭个帐篷，你知道的，

sentences.en: the owners would put us in touch with some people that we could go and work for.
sentences.zh: 房东就会介绍一些我们可以去为之工作的人。

sentences.en: Niamh's mum, Anne, remembers the level of planning for the second trip.
sentences.zh: 妮娅姆的妈妈安回忆了第二次行程的筹备情况。

sentences.en: The first failed mission had given Niamh insight into what she would need and she set about organising what she would take with her.
sentences.zh: 第一次失败的经历让妮娅姆对她需要什么有了直观的了解，她着手整理她要随身携带的东西。

sentences.en: She knew she'd have to have shirts with long sleeves so she hit Vinnies and the Salvos and places like that and got long-sleeved shirts that she could wear fruit picking
sentences.zh: 她知道自己必须穿长袖衬衫，所以她去了文尼慈善店、救世军旧货店之类的地方，买了几件摘水果时可以穿的长袖衬衫，

sentences.en: and she didn't take anything that was peripheral or extra, took no jewellery except for one ticky on a thong that she wore around her neck which had been a gift from her godmother.
sentences.zh: 她没有带任何多余或非必需的东西，除了教母送的一件系在细带上挂在脖子上的饰物外，没有带任何首饰。

sentences.en: And she had her camera gear with her.
sentences.zh: 她随身带着她的相机设备。

sentences.en: She also, when she'd gone down earlier in the year, she came home, indexed all her photos, labelled them, dated them.
sentences.zh: 而且，当她今年早些时候回来时，她把所有的照片都进行了索引、贴标签、标上日期。

sentences.en: She had been saving and putting aside things for when she needed to be at uni.
sentences.zh: 她一直在存钱，为上大学时需要用的东西做准备。

sentences.en: While Niamh was back home, she spoke to another friend, Lisa.
sentences.zh: 在妮娅姆回老家期间，她和另一个朋友丽莎聊了聊。

sentences.en: She convinced her to go to Batlow as well.
sentences.zh: 她也说服丽莎一起去巴特洛。

sentences.en: So when she finished school, I knew she had plans to go and study in Sydney and live with Fanula and she was planning to go to film school.
sentences.zh: 所以当她高中毕业时，我知道她计划去悉尼读书，跟范妮拉住在一起，她还计划去电影学院。

sentences.en: She really, and which actually initially surprised me because she excelled so much in so many other areas.
sentences.zh: 她真的——这其实最初让我很惊讶，因为她在很多其他领域都非常优秀。

sentences.en: But there was this creative streak to her that I think she wanted to tell stories and, yeah, and it was a passion that she had.
sentences.zh: 但她有一种创造力，我想她是想讲故事，而且，是的，那是她的一大热情所在。

sentences.en: At the end of year 12, see, I left school a little before the others and I went and started working.
sentences.zh: 看吧，在12年级结束时，我比其他人稍微早一点离开学校，出去工作了。

sentences.en: And so I was a little bit disconnected from Niamh and probably my other friends for a little while.
sentences.zh: 所以我有一小段时间跟妮娅姆以及可能我的其他朋友都有点疏远了。

sentences.en: And then, funnily enough, when she was in, she'd been in Batlow and she came home and she called me and I spoke to her.
sentences.zh: 然后，有趣的是，当她在巴特洛的时候，她回了家，给我打了电话，我和她聊了聊。

sentences.en: And she was like, oh, yeah, I've been down there, we're making money and it's, you know, she was telling me about things that were happening down there.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，是的，我一直在那边，我们在赚钱，而且，你知道的，她跟我讲了那边发生的事情。

sentences.en: And I said, oh, well, I'm kind of looking for work.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，好吧，我正好在找工作。

sentences.en: And she's like, oh, you should come down.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，你应该过来。

sentences.en: It's really easy.
sentences.zh: 这真的很轻松。

sentences.en: Anyone can get work.
sentences.zh: 谁都能找到工作。

sentences.en: So I was like, oh, OK.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，哦，好吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, all right.
sentences.zh: 好吧，行。

sentences.en: I'll come down.
sentences.zh: 我过去。

sentences.en: I'll come and do a couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 我去干上几周。

sentences.en: And I saw her briefly.
sentences.zh: 我和她匆匆见了一面。

sentences.en: She said, yeah, I'm just picking up some stuff and heading back down.
sentences.zh: 她说，好的，我收拾点东西就马上赶回去。

sentences.en: The day before we were going to leave, we were walking through the mall.
sentences.zh: 我们要离开的前一天，我们正在购物中心散步。

sentences.en: We come from a small town, so we're just walking through town.
sentences.zh: 我们来自一个小镇，所以我们只是在镇上散步。

sentences.en: And this younger girl that we knew by association, you know, friends of friends, she was hanging out and we approached her and asked her what she was doing.
sentences.zh: 有个我们通过熟人认识的年轻女孩，你知道的，就是朋友的朋友，她在闲逛，我们走过去问她在做什么。

sentences.en: And we were pretty excited.
sentences.zh: 我们当时挺兴奋的。

sentences.en: We were like, you know, it's summertime, it's February.
sentences.zh: 我们就像是，你知道的，现在是夏天，是二月。

sentences.en: We don't have to go to school.
sentences.zh: 我们不用上学。

sentences.en: You know, we're going to go fruit picking and make some money, buy a car, go on a road trip.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们要去摘水果赚钱，买辆车，去公路旅行。

sentences.en: So Brodie was younger than us.
sentences.zh: 所以布罗迪比我们小。

sentences.en: So I would have been 18 and I reckon Brodie would have been 15.
sentences.zh: 那我当时应该是18岁，我估计布罗迪当时大概15岁。

sentences.en: I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 我不确定。

sentences.en: And we were like, come fruit picking if you're not going to go to school.
sentences.zh: 我们当时说，如果你不去上学，就跟我们一起去摘水果吧。

sentences.en: And so Brodie decided to come with us and she went and booked a train ticket.
sentences.zh: 于是布罗迪决定和我们一起去，她去订了一张火车票。

sentences.en: Brodie and Niam had hit it off right from the start, even though Brodie was younger.
sentences.zh: 布罗迪和妮娅姆一拍即合，尽管布罗迪年龄更小。

sentences.en: I don't remember the first time we actually met.
sentences.zh: 我不记得我们第一次真正见面是什么时候了。

sentences.en: I just know that we kind of met through our group of friends.
sentences.zh: 我只知道我们是通过我们的朋友圈认识的。

sentences.en: Like I was a fire twirler and I was in a group and me and Jess would go fire twirling with them a lot.
sentences.zh: 比如我是玩火棍的，我加入了一个团体，我和杰丝经常跟他们一起玩火棍。

sentences.en: And I think Jess and Niam went to high school together.
sentences.zh: 我想杰丝和妮娅姆一起上过高中。

sentences.en: So I probably met Niam through Jess.
sentences.zh: 所以我可能是通过杰丝认识妮娅姆的。

sentences.en: And yeah, we just would be at parties together.
sentences.zh: 对，我们经常一起去参加派对。

sentences.en: And I just remember we, there was one party in particular where we started hanging out.
sentences.zh: 我只记得我们，有个派对让我印象深刻，我们开始一起玩。

sentences.en: I already knew her, but we hung out a lot more.
sentences.zh: 我本来就认识她，但我们在一起玩得更多了。

sentences.en: Brodie's favourite story of Niam reminds me of the saying, dance like no one is watching.
sentences.zh: 布罗迪最喜欢的一个关于妮娅姆的故事让我想起了一句话：像没有人在看一样跳舞。

sentences.en: She really was into like System of a Down at the time.
sentences.zh: 她当时真的很迷“堕落体制”乐队。

sentences.en: And yeah, the Toxicity album.
sentences.zh: 对，还有他们的《Toxicity》专辑。

sentences.en: And I just remember catching her one time, listening to it, and she was like just dancing really funny.
sentences.zh: 我只记得有一次撞见她在听这张专辑，她跳的舞超级搞笑。

sentences.en: It was really awkward, but it was really, really cute.
sentences.zh: 动作真的很别扭，但真的非常非常可爱。

sentences.en: And she was just like just having fun by herself.
sentences.zh: 她当时就一个人玩得很开心。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, I love that album.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，我太喜欢这张专辑了。

sentences.en: And then she was like, oh my God, shocked that I saw her.
sentences.zh: 然后她就说，天哪，看到我撞见她，她吓了一跳。

sentences.en: And I think that's probably my favourite kind of memory of her.
sentences.zh: 我想这可能是我对她最喜欢的记忆了。

sentences.en: When Niam and Jess suggested she come fruit picking with them, Brodie cleared it with her mum and left the next day.
sentences.zh: 当妮娅姆和杰丝邀请她一起去摘水果时，布罗迪征得母亲同意，第二天就出发了。

sentences.en: I was at TAFE and I had took a lunch break and I walked uptown and I bumped into Jess.
sentences.zh: 当时我在TAFE（职业技术学院），趁午休时间我走到镇上，碰到了杰丝。

sentences.en: And she was like, oh, me and Niam are going to go fruit picking, like you should come.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，我和妮娅姆要去除水果，你应该一起来。

sentences.en: And I was like, okay, like I'll come.
sentences.zh: 我说，好啊，那我跟你们去。

sentences.en: And I, yeah, ran back down to see my mum because she was also doing TAFE with me at the same time.
sentences.zh: 然后，是的，我跑回去找我妈妈，因为她当时也和我一起在TAFE上课。

sentences.en: And yeah, I got some money off her and we pretty much left the very next day.
sentences.zh: 是的，我从她那里拿了些钱，基本上第二天我们就出发了。

sentences.en: So it was really spare of the moment.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的是临时起意。

sentences.en: On Valentine's Day, Thursday the 14th of February 2002, Niam, Jess and Brodie left Armidale.
sentences.zh: 在2002年2月14日星期四情人节那天，妮娅姆、杰丝和布罗迪离开阿马代尔。

sentences.en: They planned to stay with Fennulla in Sydney for the night where she was studying and working before heading south to Batlow.
sentences.zh: 她们计划在悉尼在读书和工作的范妮拉那里住上一晚，然后才南下前往巴特洛。

sentences.en: Brian remembers saying goodbye to his youngest daughter.
sentences.zh: 布赖恩回忆起向小女儿告别的情景。

sentences.en: So off she went and the last thing she was hopping into the car out here.
sentences.zh: 就这样她出发了，她在这里跳上车的最后一幕。

sentences.en: Just out in front of the garage, about to go off to catch the train with her friends.
sentences.zh: 就在车库门前，正准备和朋友们去赶火车。

sentences.en: And she, I was standing at the top of the steps and she dashed over and gave me a big hug and hopped in the car with Anne and off she went.
sentences.zh: 当时我站在台阶顶上，她跑过来给我一个大大的拥抱，跳上安的车，然后就出发了。

sentences.en: Jess also remembers when it came time to say goodbye to their families as they took the train to Sydney.
sentences.zh: 杰丝也记得当她们坐火车去悉尼时，与家人道别的情景。

sentences.en: From the moment the three girls hopped on the train that morning, an uneasy feeling began to bury itself in the pit of her stomach.
sentences.zh: 从那天早上三个女孩跳上火车的那一刻起，一种不安的感觉就开始在她的胃里扎根。

sentences.en: It would stay there and grow as time went on.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这种感觉一直在那里并不断滋长。

sentences.en: And the next day we went to the train station and we got on the train and I sat on the left side and Niam and Brodie sat together on the right side.
sentences.zh: 第二天我们去了火车站上了车，我坐在左边，妮娅姆和布罗迪一起坐在右边。

sentences.en: And my mum stood outside on the platform and she like waved a white handkerchief.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈站在站台上，挥舞着一块白手帕。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh my God, she's so embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 我说，天哪，她太尴尬了。

sentences.en: You know, there were tears running down her eyes.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，眼泪顺着她的眼眶流了下来。

sentences.en: And I remember Niam's mum standing there too, looking very stern and concerned, you know, just very serious.
sentences.zh: 我记得妮娅姆的妈妈也站在那里，看起来非常严厉和担忧，你知道的，非常严肃。

sentences.en: And I noticed that Brodie and Niam were just getting along really well.
sentences.zh: 我注意到布罗迪和妮娅姆相处得非常融洽。

sentences.en: And I had a really funny feeling and I didn't like it.
sentences.zh: 我有一种非常奇怪的感觉，而且我很不喜欢这种感觉。

sentences.en: And I didn't like how well they were getting along with each other.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌她们俩关系那么好。

sentences.en: Kind of, it probably made me feel jealous because I was like, oh, you know, they're getting along a lot better than I am.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，这可能让我感到嫉妒，因为我想，哦，你知道的，她们比我相处得好得多。

sentences.en: This is weird.
sentences.zh: 这太奇怪了。

sentences.en: Maybe we shouldn't have Brodie coming with us because she's only 15.
sentences.zh: 也许我们不该让布罗迪跟我们一起来，因为她才15岁。

sentences.en: Fanula remembers Niam and her friends arriving at her place in Sydney.
sentences.zh: 范妮拉回忆起妮娅姆和她的朋友们抵达她在悉尼的住所的情景。

sentences.en: They had a great time together.
sentences.zh: 她们在一起度过了一段美好的时光。

sentences.en: And then 14th of February, she came back to Sydney with Jess and another girl, Brodie, from Armidale.
sentences.zh: 然后2月14日，她和杰丝以及来自阿马代尔的另一个女孩布罗迪回到了悉尼。

sentences.en: They came to Sydney.
sentences.zh: 她们来到了悉尼。

sentences.en: She came into the city and met me and I was, I'd just finished work.
sentences.zh: 她来到城里见了我，我当时刚下班。

sentences.en: So we went out for a couple of drinks with our brother, Kieran, and then headed home.
sentences.zh: 所以我们和哥哥基兰出去喝了几杯，然后就回家了。

sentences.en: I was living with two flatmates in Chatswood in a musty old manky share house.
sentences.zh: 我当时和两个室友住在车士活的一个又霉又旧的合租房里。

sentences.en: And yeah, they crashed on our lounge room floor and we just hung out.
sentences.zh: 是的，她们在我们的客厅地板上对付了一宿，我们就一起闲逛。

sentences.en: But yeah, then the next morning she headed off and I just remember them like heading off and waving and me being like, be careful, call me, all that sort of stuff.
sentences.zh: 但是，第二天早上她就出发了，我只记得她们出发时挥手告别，而我说着注意安全、给我打电话之类的话。

sentences.en: And I remember for a fleeting second thinking, oh, I should give her my phone because I had a mobile phone at that stage and she didn't.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一瞬间闪过一个念头：哦，我应该把我的手机给她，因为当时我有一部手机而她没有。

sentences.en: And I remember thinking I should give her my phone.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时想把手机给她。

sentences.en: And then I was like, oh, but, you know, like they were already heading off and it's, you know, a hassle to sort out the bills or replacements and all that sort of stuff.
sentences.zh: 然后我想，哦，但是，你知道的，她们已经准备出发了，处理话费账单或换手机之类的挺麻烦的。

sentences.en: And so I didn't.
sentences.zh: 所以我没给。

sentences.en: Um, I mean, I've got a lot of small regrets and that's one of them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，我有许多小小的遗憾，这就是其中之一。

sentences.en: Realistically, there was no reception down there anyway, so I don't think it would have made much difference.
sentences.zh: 现实地说，那边本来也没有手机信号，所以我觉得有没有手机没什么太大区别。

sentences.en: The train trip to Batlow perhaps set the scene for what was to follow.
sentences.zh: 去巴特洛的火车之旅或许为接下来的事情埋下了伏笔。

sentences.en: The plan was for the girls to catch the 7.15am train from Sydney to Cootamundra and from there catch a Country Link bus to Batlow.
sentences.zh: 按计划，女孩们将乘坐早上7点15分从悉尼开往库塔蒙德的火车，并在那里换乘Country Link巴士前往巴特洛。

sentences.en: They missed the train from Sydney and had to wait around for a later one.
sentences.zh: 她们错过了从悉尼出发的火车，只好等着坐下一班。

sentences.en: Jess explains.
sentences.zh: 杰丝解释道。

sentences.en: And that was a really weird thing that we missed the train because we would never miss a train.
sentences.zh: 我们竟然错过了火车，这真的很奇怪，因为我们从来不会错过火车。

sentences.en: And I remember it was like the world was trying to stop it from the very start.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时的感觉就像是整个世界从一开始就试图阻止这一切。

sentences.en: And when, like, I remember Niamh being really stressed out and getting so cross and angry that we'd missed the train.
sentences.zh: 当，我记得妮娅姆压力非常大，因为错过火车而感到非常生气和恼火。

sentences.en: And I thought, this is so unlike it.
sentences.zh: 我想，这太不像她的风格了。

sentences.en: But when you miss a train, eventually another one follows and the girls were able to hop on board.
sentences.zh: 但错过了火车，总会有下一班，女孩们最终还是上了车。

sentences.en: Unlike Jess, who felt a strange foreboding about the trip, their younger travelling companion, Brodie, did not.
sentences.zh: 与对行程感到一种奇怪预感的杰丝不同，她们年轻的旅伴布罗迪并没有这种感觉。

sentences.en: The train trip from Sydney to Cootamundra, me and Niamh were having lots of fun and chatting to strangers.
sentences.zh: 从悉尼到库塔蒙德的火车上，我和妮娅姆玩得很开心，还跟陌生人聊天。

sentences.en: Remember, we turned our chair around to talk to these people that were there and we had a few drinks and we were just having a good time.
sentences.zh: 记得吗，我们把座位转过来和旁边的人聊天，我们喝了几杯酒，玩得很开心。

sentences.en: It was just an adventure.
sentences.zh: 这只是一次冒险。

sentences.en: I didn't feel nervous particularly.
sentences.zh: 我并没有感到特别紧张。

sentences.en: I always wanted to get away from Armadale.
sentences.zh: 我一直都想离开阿马代尔。

sentences.en: Like, I was always leaving, running away.
sentences.zh: 就好像，我总是在离开，在逃跑。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, it was just another adventure, really.
sentences.zh: 所以，这真的只是又一次冒险而已。

sentences.en: But for Jess, the further from home they got, the more her uneasiness grew.
sentences.zh: 但对杰丝来说，离家越远，她内心的不安就越重。

sentences.en: We got on this train from Sydney to Cootamundra.
sentences.zh: 我们坐上了从悉尼开往库塔芒德拉的火车。

sentences.en: And when we got on the train, it was nearing night time.
sentences.zh: 当我们上车时，天色已经快黑了。

sentences.en: And Niamh and Brodie were sitting together on the left-hand side seat in front of me.
sentences.zh: 尼娅姆和布罗迪坐在我前面左侧的座位上。

sentences.en: And this group of men were sitting on the right-hand side and they were all drinking and it made me feel nervous.
sentences.zh: 右边坐着一群男人，他们都在喝酒，这让我感到很紧张。

sentences.en: And so, I pretended to go to sleep and then I fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 于是，我假装睡觉，然后就真的睡着了。

sentences.en: Because I knew that Brodie and Niamh were like, yeah, you know, let's drink with these guys.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道布罗迪和尼娅姆大概会想，太好了，你知道的，咱们跟这帮人喝一杯吧。

sentences.en: And I don't know if they did drink with these guys.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们最后是不是真的跟这帮人一起喝了酒。

sentences.en: They were like a rough group of old men.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来像是一群粗鲁的老年男子。

sentences.en: And then I fell asleep and I woke up and all of the, like, the small group of men that had been drinking were now asleep and snoring.
sentences.zh: 后来我睡着了，醒来时发现之前喝酒的那小撮人现在都睡着了，而且在打呼噜。

sentences.en: Because they had missed their original train, there was no Country Link bus to take them to Batlow
sentences.zh: 由于他们错过了原本的列车，当他们在深夜抵达偏远的库塔芒德拉火车站时，

sentences.en: when they arrived at the remote Cootamundra train station in the dead of the night.
sentences.zh: 已经没有开往巴特洛的城际连线巴士了。

sentences.en: As Jess sat on the train, she knew they would have to find their own way to Batlow, which was 120 kilometres away from Cootamundra.
sentences.zh: 当杰丝坐在火车上时，她知道他们必须自己想办法去120公里外的巴特洛。

sentences.en: Jess kept a diary on the trip and this was her entry about that train ride.
sentences.zh: 杰丝在旅行期间写了日记，这是她关于那次火车之行的记录。

sentences.en: There were revolting men on the train who I felt really sorry for.
sentences.zh: 火车上有那些令人作呕的男人，我其实挺替他们感到难过的。

sentences.en: Niamh and Brodie, I thought, behaved.
sentences.zh: 我觉得尼娅姆和布罗迪表现得还可以。

sentences.en: I don't know how they behaved, but I was saddened and I'm not impressed with
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们表现得到底怎么样，但我很难过，而且我对

sentences.en: the rude, obnoxious, drunk attitudes of a group of people who were much older.
sentences.zh: 那些比他们年长得多的人所表现出的粗鲁、讨厌和醉酒的态度感到很不满。

sentences.en: Jesus ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: This would be very funny to watch on a film.
sentences.zh: 如果在电影里看这个，一定非常有意思。

sentences.en: At the beginning of the film, everything is so optimistic and positive, but slowly, after the train tracks, the mood changes and it becomes uncomfortably evil.
sentences.zh: 电影刚开始时，一切都那么乐观积极，但渐渐地，在驶过铁轨之后，气氛变了，变得有一种让人不舒服的邪门。

sentences.en: Coming up on Missing Niamh.
sentences.zh: 接下来请收看《寻找尼娅姆》。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, people would just come up to the tents and be like, hey, and what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 对啊，人们会直接走到帐篷旁边，然后说，嘿，你们在干什么呢？

sentences.en: You know, just there wasn't really a lot of privacy.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，基本上没什么隐私可言。

sentences.en: And then one day the black hearse arrived.
sentences.zh: 直到有一天，那辆黑色的灵车来了。

sentences.en: And when the black hearse arrived, these two men got out.
sentences.zh: 当黑色的灵车抵达时，从上面下来了两个男人。

sentences.en: And as soon as I saw them and I saw that black hearse, I thought, they're baddies, stay away from them.
sentences.zh: 我一看到他们和那辆黑色的灵车，心里就想：他们是坏人，离他们远点。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 谢谢收听。

sentences.zh: 如果你想收听《寻找尼娅姆》的剩余内容，只需在你平时获取播客的平台搜索即可。
